test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 24 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Pipe A can fill a tank in 6 minutes, while pipe B can empty the completely filled tank in 12 minutes. Initially, pipe A is opened and after 2 minutes pipe B is also opened. In how much time (in minutes) will the remaining tank be filled completely?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total capacity = LCM of 6 and 12 = 12 units.

Efficiency of filling Pipe A = +2 units/min | Efficiency of emptying Pipe B = −1 unit/min.

Work completed by A in first 2 mins = 2 × 2 = 4 units.

Remaining work = 12 − 4 = 8 units.

Time for (A + B) to complete the remaining work = 8 ÷ (2 − 1) = 8 minutes.

**∴ The correct answer is 8 minutes.**
